scope: Remove structural-ID lexical matches, separate exact matching from numeric score, and select reading evidence independently of Document score. Source-body evidence and Document metadata coverage are separate metrics.

freeze_before_first_observation.policy: Known 46 cases are regression only. Six independently prepared synthetic cases first opened after code freeze; at most two search pages at each case budget, no gold-based early stopping. Evaluate original body/evidence groups separately from Document metadata discovery.

discarded_candidate.change: Independently choose the highest-scoring unit including heading-less root Section.
discarded_candidate.reason: Lost exact-korean-alias-with-relations on the known suite by replacing the readable heading with frontmatter provenance. The final candidate leaves root provenance in its existing separate path.

mcp_smoke.purpose: Fresh SDK stdio MCP verification only. Candidate totals are observed transport output, not a source-selection or answer-quality evaluation.

reproduction.comparison_method: Run pinned baseline query and current query with common unchanged runtime helpers, source snapshot, scopes, case budgets and dirty state. Search at most two pages, without gold-based stopping. Canonical query hashes are in the freeze record.

limits: Two new negative cases still return unrelated candidates.
Four positive first-observation cases are too few for a broad generalization claim.
matched_terms and candidate counts are lexical metadata, not semantic truth or answer correctness.

Update max_section_term_matches from local exact-candidate body matches as well as metadata matches.
Make bounded coverage-gap summaries idempotent, retaining hidden counts and the known total while emitting at most one omission summary.
